fact_text: The Insurance Ombudsman (Wafaqi Insurance Mohtasib) received about 10,000 complaints in 2024 from across Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Life insurance draws more complaints to the Ombudsman than general insurance does.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Bancassurance, insurance sold through bank channels, was the category producing the most complaints to the Ombudsman.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: About 9,000 complaints were disposed of in 2024, out of roughly 10,000 received.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: About 90% of complaints disposed of in 2024 ended in a mutually agreed settlement.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Around 7-10% of complaints end in a speaking order, a legal decision issued when one party refuses to settle.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Around 3-4% of cases go to review or representation, which the Ombudsman's office decides as the final forum.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: A party unhappy with the Ombudsman's review can appeal to the President of Pakistan under the Federal Insurance Ombudsman Institution Reforms Act 2013.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: The law requires a complaint to be resolved within 60 days, and delays of 10-15 days occur when a key document is outstanding.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: A complaint is registered, given an initial hearing by consultants, appraised by advisers, and then put to the Ombudsman, who signs the decision.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Complaints can be filed in person by handwritten submission, through an online form on the Ombudsman's website, by calling helpline 1082, or by courier.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: The Ombudsman has about eight offices across Pakistan, including Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Multan, Lahore, Islamabad and Peshawar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Policyholders get a 15-day free-look period after receiving a policy, to review it or have it explained by someone else.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Bancassurance was adopted in Pakistan's insurance market from around 2009-10, when banks began acting as corporate agents for insurers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: The Ombudsman says bank-sold policies are often presented as investments, and buyers are not told until late in the sale that they are buying insurance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: The Ombudsman attributes bancassurance mis-selling partly to poor agent training, with bank staff or insurer staff selling policies they do not fully understand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Sales claims that a sum will double in three or five years are unrealistic, the Ombudsman said; buyers should check the 10- and 15-year payout illustrations instead.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Illustrated payouts in a policy are tentative and can differ by about 5% either way from the figure shown.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: If a policyholder stops paying, the contract's signed amounts apply after the stated years, but the Ombudsman tries to secure at least the premiums already paid.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: In the Ombudsman's illustrative 10-year policy, administrative costs are expected to be covered by about year five, after which the payout grows.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Claims lodged with the Ombudsman in 2024 totalled about PKR 3 billion, relating to roughly 10,000 complaints.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: The Ombudsman secured about PKR 2.35 billion in relief for consumers in 2024 through the complaints it disposed of.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: The insurance sector has about 42-43 companies, including takaful operators offering Islamic insurance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Complaint counts track company size: the illustration given was 100 complaints for 1,000 policies sold and 50 for 500, so large insurers draw more complaints.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Insurers in their second and third years of operation draw fewer complaints than large, established companies, the Ombudsman observed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Insurers sometimes issue guarantees between two parties, with a third party giving the guarantee, but government contracts mostly rely on bank guarantees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: An insurance policy is a contract of indemnity, and once both parties sign, both are bound by its terms.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: The Ombudsman worked with SECP to issue a circular requiring its name in policy documents, so policyholders know a forum exists for fraud or misselling.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: Buyers can check that an insurer is licensed by looking it up on the SECP website's list of registered insurance companies, about 40-42 in number.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)

fact_text: The Ombudsman's first aim is a mediated, mutually agreeable settlement through arbitration and mediation, so that a legal appeal is not needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Insurance Claims Denied? Know Your Rights with Pakistan’s Insurance Ombudsman | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-02)
